title: Renting Films Online in the Netherlands in 2026: Where and What It Costs
html:
Renting a film online takes a minute: pick the film, pay once, press play. The hard part is knowing which service has the film you want, and at what price, because every film sits on different services in different countries.

The short answer: search the film on Riftn Cinema. It shows every legal way to watch it in the Netherlands: which subscription includes it, where you can rent it, what the rental costs and what it costs to buy, in euros. Then rent it from the service with the best price.

Where can you rent films online in the Netherlands?

  • Pathé Thuis: the cinema chain's own rental service, with new releases and premiere films that are still in cinemas. Also available through KPN and Ziggo.
  • Apple TV: rent or buy films on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and many smart TVs.
  • Google TV: rent or buy films on Android, Google TV and in the browser.
  • Your TV provider: KPN and Ziggo sell rentals through their own on-demand menus.

Not every film is on every service. That is why it pays to search once and compare.

What does renting a film cost?

  • A recent film: usually about 5 to 7 euros to rent.
  • An older film: often cheaper, and sometimes discounted.
  • A premiere film still in cinemas: costs more than a normal rental.
  • Buying instead: costs more than renting, but you keep the film in your library.

Prices change per service and per film. Riftn Cinema shows the live price for the Netherlands next to each service.

How long do you get to watch a rented film?

At most services you have a set number of days to start the film and, once you press play, a limited time to finish it, often 48 hours. Check the terms before you pay, especially if you plan to watch in two sittings.

Renting, streaming or buying?

  • Rent when you want one film, once, without a subscription.
  • Stream when the film is already included in a subscription you pay for, such as Netflix or Videoland. Riftn Cinema shows that too, so you do not pay twice.
  • Buy when it is a film you will watch again.

How to find the cheapest legal option

  1. Open riftn.com/cinema.
  2. Search the film or series.
  3. Compare where it streams, where you can rent it and what it costs to buy, all for the Netherlands.
  4. Click through to the service you choose and watch.

Rights differ per country. A film can be included in a subscription in one country, a paid rental in another and unavailable in a third. Cinema checks per country, so you only see what you can really watch.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I rent a film online?

In the Netherlands at Pathé Thuis, Apple TV, Google TV and through KPN and Ziggo. Search the film on Riftn Cinema to see which of them has it.

What does it cost to rent a film?

Usually about 5 to 7 euros for a recent film, less for older films, more for premiere films still in cinemas.

Can I rent a film without a subscription?

Yes. A rental is a one-off payment. You do not need a subscription.

Is it legal to rent films online?

Yes, through official services like the ones above. Sites that offer new cinema releases for free are almost always illegal.

Riftn is a social media protocol, with free tools such as Cinema and free live TV built in. Find your film on Riftn Cinema.
